prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production asset: high-quality hand-painted motorcycle-rider action sprite atlas.
Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: an approved4-column by4-row sprite template, sixteen complete sprites. Image2 is an identity/material reference ONLY. Edit the rider pose in every cell of Image1 for an ACCELERATION RESPONSE. Keep exactly sixteen sprites in exactly the same4x4 layout. The upper two rows are eight consecutive directions in the MILD/MIDPOINT stage. The lower two rows repeat those EXACT SAME eight directions in the FULL stage. Read row-major within each half. Preserve EACH cell's specific yaw angle from Image1: these are only RIGHT PROFILE through FRONT-RIGHT, eight tiny angular increments, NOT a generic full turnaround. Upper/lower matching cells must have the identical view and identical bike.
The rider responds to strong acceleration: hips stay on the SAME saddle, knees grip the tank, elbows bend and the upper torso inclines slightly FORWARD to brace against the pull. Mild stage has a small5-degree torso inclination; full stage has a clear12-degree forward torso inclination with helmet a little lower and forward. Both hands hold the SAME handlebars and both boots stay on their SAME pegs. No wheelie or moving wheels.
Keep the approved slim rider identity, SAME unchanged round helmet diameter, SAME torso and limb dimensions, brown padded leather suit, bronze helmet with black visor, olive-bronze dual-sport motorcycle, rack, exhaust and chain on their true physical sides. Preserve the MOTORCYCLE pixel geometry as closely as possible: wheel centres, tire diameter, wheelbase, chassis, saddle, lights, mirrors and handlebars stay the same. No bike yaw change, steering, deformation or perspective change. Only physically plausible articulation of the rider changes. Preserve the established fine painted texture and warm bronze/olive/brown palette; improve crisp fine detail. One fixed orthographic camera, lighting and model scale throughout. Critical: helmet and wheels never grow or shrink from cell to cell or between action stages.
Output high-resolution square PNG, ideally2048x2048, exactly4 columns by4 rows, one complete cutout per cell. Use the cell area generously like Image1 while leaving clear empty gutters and safe edges. TRUE transparent background, crisp clean antialiasing, no matte, haze, halos, colored fringe, detached specks, shadows, scenery, text or grid lines. Do not copy the same upright pose sixteen times: upper two rows must show the mild action and lower two rows must show its visibly stronger full action.
